title: Compiler diagnostics are structured only at the external CLI boundary
observed_need: Compile-fail and diagnostic tests must match diagnostic identity and preserve source spans without scraping human prose.
current_language_behavior: mncs validate and mncs test-inventory emit versioned structured diagnostics with code, stage, severity, and source span; there is still no typed diagnostic value for an MNCS test program itself.
why_insufficient: The adapter can consume the stable CLI document and match codes/spans, but native diagnostic assertions cannot yet inspect compiler diagnostics directly.
minimal_reproducer: tests/fixtures/compile_fail.mncs plus tools/mncs_test.py: compile_entry consumes structured diagnostics and checks diagnostic_codes without parsing prose.
desired_direction: A versioned diagnostic value/protocol exposing code, severity, source span, related diagnostics, and rendered forms to native tooling.
workaround: The host adapter consumes only the current structured validate JSON and stores the full diagnostic array as an artifact; it does not match formatted stderr.
